incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: CRITICAL - service=ingest-proxy, symptom=5xx spike, group=canary-rollout

incident-bot: Incident created: 3105556666. PagerDuty escalation: P1 -> On-call (alex). Links: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-3105556666

alex (oncall): acked. I'm looking. any immediate customer hits? :eyes:

maya (support): seeing multiple reports from a single enterprise tenant (acme-corp) — requests for embeddings returning 502s since ~00:02 UTC. Ticket #TKT-4217

lee (sre): telemetry: canary pool p99 errors jumped from 0.2% -> 7.4% at 00:01. stack traces show upstream `tokenhash` sanitizer error in tokenizer service returning 500 causing proxy 502s.

jordan (eng-runtime): can confirm new release `embed-service@v3.9.1` rolled to canary ~00:00 with 5% traffic. Reproducer locally: send long input (~12k chars) -> tokenizer returns empty token list and service crashes with `ValueError: invalid tokenhash`

alex (oncall): ok plan: (1) divert canary traffic back to previous variant (2) pause further rollout (3) rollback canary if divert doesn't stabilize. Who can issue traffic change?

jordan (eng-runtime): I can flip the traffic weight in traffic-controller. Command: `trafficctl set-weight embed-service:v3.9.0=95,embed-service:v3.9.1=5` -> to `95/5` (we already had 95/5, need to set back to 100/0). New command: `trafficctl set-weight embed-service:v3.9.0=100,embed-service:v3.9.1=0`

lee (sre): doing quick mitigation: scaling down canary pool and setting no-serve for v3.9.1. Running `k run kubectl -n prod patch vs embed-service-canary --patch '{"spec":{"weight":0}}'`

incident-bot: DeployBot: rollout pause for `embed-service` triggered by alert rule `canary-errors-high`. Rollout paused at step 2.

jordan (eng-runtime): applied `trafficctl` update -> v3.9.1 set to 0% on traffic-controller. Confirming: canary pods are still up but not receiving new traffic.

maya (support): acme-corp says errors dropped matched timeframe, still seeing intermittent requests slow. They report 502s decreased from 48/min to 3/min.

sam (product): what's the blast radius? any other customers impacted or just acme?

lee (sre): from logs, about 92% of errors originated from the canary pool; a small % were retries hitting earlier faulty requests in the edge cache. Only 3 tenants show elevated errors (acme, beta-partner, internal-testing). Estimated customer impact window ~00:00-00:05 UTC.

alex (oncall): given traffic diverted and errors dropping, do we still want an immediate rollback or do a controlled roll-forward with fix?

jordan (eng-runtime): root cause looks like a tokenizer change in v3.9.1 that changed hashing for certain Unicode sequences — fails on long inputs. We have a patch ready (PR#812) that reverts the tokenhash normalization. I can promote the patch as v3.9.2 but need to run full canary again.

lee (sre): I'd prefer rollback of canary to avoid further customer impact. We can rollback canary pods to v3.9.0 and then test v3.9.2 in an isolated staging canary with synthetic traffic.

alex (oncall): agree. Rollback canary -> then run warmup. jordan, can you perform rollback and confirm healthchecks?

jordan (eng-runtime): initiating rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/embed-service-canary embed=redwood/embed-service:v3.9.0`

incident-bot: DeploymentBot: rollout started for embed-service-canary -> target image v3.9.0.

jordan (eng-runtime): rollout status: pods terminating -> new pods coming up. Healthchecks showing readiness 2/2 on new pods.

lee (sre): watching telemetry. p50/p95 latency stable. error rate trending down to baseline.

maya (support): ACME confirms errors gone, says their ingest queue drained. :thumbsup:

alex (oncall): nice. action items: jordan to validate v3.9.2 in staging; lee to run a postmortem template and add monitoring for `tokenhash` error; sam to draft customer comms for impacted tenants. We'll mark incident as mitigated once we confirm no new spikes for 15m.

jordan (eng-runtime): will run canary in staging with fuzz inputs and add extra unit test for long unicode sequences. PR#812 CI started.

lee (sre): adding alert enhancement: split canary errors by tokenizer-subcomponent to get earlier signals.

sam (product): customer comms draft: "We detected a canary regression affecting a small subset of customers which caused transient 502s when processing long inputs. We rolled back the canary and issued a patch. No data loss observed." I'll share draft in #customer-comms.

alex (oncall): marking PD incident as acknowledged -> mitigated. Incident window logged. I'll do a quick handoff to oncall rotation in 30m for follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-3105556666 status -> mitigated by ack (alex). Timeline saved: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-3105556666/timeline

maya (support): closing ticket TKT-4217 as resolved; will reopen if ACME reports anything else.

lee (sre): Postmortem owners assigned: lee (lead), jordan (eng), sam (customer comms). ETA first draft 24h.

alex (oncall): thanks team. tagging :party_parrot: . Closing thread after 15m of steady metrics.

incident-bot: Note: automated follow-up task created -> `/tasks create "postmortem INC-3105556666" @lee due:24h`
